title: McKesson discloses breach after ShinyHunters claims patient data theft
description: Healthcare and pharmaceutical distribution giant McKesson has disclosed a cybersecurity incident involving unauthorized access to third-party applications and data theft, with the ShinyHunters extortion group claiming it stole 284 million patient data records. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: PaperCut releases second emergency patch for exploited flaws
description: PaperCut has released a second emergency security update for two actively exploited vulnerabilities in its PaperCut NG and MF print management software after researchers discovered multiple ways to bypass the initial fixes. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: GiveWP WordPress donation plugin flaw lets hackers execute server commands
description: A maximum-severity vulnerability in the GiveWP plugin for WordPress allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the hosting server. [...]
author: Bill Toulas
